mentions.name: Parsnip AI learning infrastructure
mentions.description: A skills-based personalized learning platform that teaches people different skills at different times starting from different places. Generalized beyond cooking to education in other domains (K-12, higher ed, workforce) as B2B2B AI learning infrastructure.
mentions.problem: Building the cooking app required first figuring out how to teach people different skills at different times, all starting from different places, and helping fund the app's creation.
